_meta.scope: Australia: customs duty 5% ad valorem (general rate, Schedule 3 chapter 22) plus the excise-equivalent customs duty at ATO excise rates for beer and spirits; Wine Equalisation Tax 29% on wine, cider, perry, mead and sake; GST 10% on CIF + duty + excise/WET.
notes: Excise rates from 3 August 2026 (ATO, indexed each February and August; draught-beer items frozen until August 2027).

Beer: duty applies only to alcohol above 1.15% ABV. Packaged beer (≤48 L containers not for pump delivery) is modelled; draught (kegs >48 L or pump-ready 8–48 L) is lower (43.39/LAL at >3.5%) and not modelled.

WET is charged on the customs value + duty + transport and insurance (≈ CIF + duty) for imports, i.e. modelled as 29% ad valorem on CIF + duty. Wine, cider, perry, mead and sake between 1.15% and 22% ABV are WET goods; above 22% they are spirits.
Preferential rates (Free under ChAFTA, JAEPA, KAFTA, CPTPP, A-UKFTA, AANZFTA…) remove the 5% ad valorem only; the excise-equivalent component always applies.
Not yet checked against an import declaration — tier official.
